scientific_integrity: The minimax lower bound follows from path-event inclusion. The source confidence-horizon theorem supplies the Brownian calibration and identifies the q=1/2 power boundary. Literature comparison was statement-based; two older primary sources were available only through abstracts/metadata during this review, which is retained as a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Brownian/asymptotic calibration only; deterministic pre-specified boundary shapes; criterion is worst fixed-time-relative half-width; no finite-sample, uniqueness, power, or expected-stopping-time claim.
title: Square-root confidence horizons are globally minimax for worst fixed-time-relative width
